instruction: Query the OQMD database for Ga-N compounds with band gap between 1.0 and 2.0 eV (element_set=Ga,N AND band_gap>1.0 AND band_gap<2.0), save the total count and first result's details to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_10.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
